description: Revert to the larger global batch size (2^19) to maximize throughput and the number of gradient steps within the 5-minute budget, which was the primary driver of the previous best result (0.9830) when combined with the 8-layer/128-dim architecture and the aggressive Muon learning rate (0.035); the previous OOM with this batch size was likely due to temporary memory fragmentation or a specific run anomaly, as the 2^18 batch size reduced the effective learning speed despite saving VRAM.
